source: global.b=await require('/workspace/SRM_System/node_modules/playwright').chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',args:['--no-sandbox']});global.c=await b.newContext({viewport:{width:1024,height:768}});await c.tracing.start({screenshots:true,snapshots:true});global.p=await c.newPage();bind(p);await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8952');await openD('#uiProjectDetails');await p.locator('#pilotNewWorkspace').click();await nav('items');if(!await p.locator('#itemIntake').isVisible())await p.locator('#toggleItemIntake').click();await p.locator('#importFile').setInputFiles('/tmp/p24/fixtures/one-material.xlsx');await p.locator('#confirmImportRows').click();await save();await p.locator('#uiOpenDrawings').click();await p.locator('#pilotDrawingLine').selectOption('RFQ-L00001');await p.locator('#pilotDrawingFiles').setInputFiles('/tmp/p24/fixtures/valid-U24-D16.pdf');await p.locator('#pilotDrawingUpload').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#pilotDrawingInfo').textContent.includes('份真实 PDF 原件'));await save();await p.locator('#uiDrawingTools > summary').click();await p.locator('#itemBody [data-drawing="RFQ-L00001"]').click();await p.waitForTimeout(15000);await shot('18-valid-PDF-after-15s');await tell('valid PDF native frame state',await p.locator('#drawingLarge').innerHTML());await tell('native frame list',p.frames().map(f=>({url:f.url(),name:f.name()})));global.pdfValid=fp('19-valid-PDF','/tmp/p24/pdfdata');await check('supplemental PDF does not alter main RFQs',fp('20-main-after-PDF'),final);await p.close();await c.tracing.stop({path:root+'valid-PDF-supplement-trace.zip'});await b.close();console.log('PDF_SUPPLEMENT_COMPLETE');
